_readme: The Three Factions, the Royal Hierarchy and open community proposals. Follower counts are NOT stored here: they come from the census in data/kingdom.json. Only genuine, approved community petitions belong here. Never add invented votes, winners, rankings or promotions.

factions.name: The Order of the Ember
factions.heraldry: Crimson and gold, bearing a flame
factions.identity: Dragonkeepers and keepers of ancient magic.

petition.author: @AkhiFR
petition.text: A dragon to defend thy king 🐉

points: King Mesmer receives a mysterious obsidian-black dragon egg, marked with glowing violet patterns.
Its violet glow bears a curious resemblance to the Hollowing. What that means, no one yet knows.

factions.name: The Stonewright Guild
factions.heraldry: Stone-grey and gold, bearing a hammer and stone

petition.author: Apple.222
petition.text: we need a house for me and a wall to protect from animals

points: Mesmer lays the foundation of a house. It is not finished yet.
He builds a knee-high defensive wall, and it stops a curious wandering boar.
This is community-requested story progress, separate from the kingdom's Village and Defences milestones.

factions.name: The Moonveil Court
factions.heraldry: Midnight blue, silver and violet, bearing a veiled crescent
factions.identity: Keepers of mystery, creativity and unrealised potential.
factions.invitation: The Court awaits its first eligible community petition. Instagram Zaunites: comment on our posts to shape your faction's future.
